source_name: NBU — Instant Payment System (IPS / миттєві платежі) pages
why_relevant: Official description and adoption status of Ukraine's instant credit transfer rail — participant bank counts, launch milestones, and its relationship to card rails (a substitution threat to scheme volumes).

source_name: NBU — System of Electronic Payments (СЕП / SEP 4.x, ISO 20022) pages and development roadmap
why_relevant: SEP is the national RTGS/credit-transfer backbone; its ISO 20022 migration, tracking service and 2025-2030 roadmap define the non-card rail and Ukraine's SEPA-alignment path — core cross-border infrastructure context for this cell.

source_name: NBU Payment Infrastructure Oversight Reports (Звіт з оверсайту)
why_relevant: Annual oversight reports carry structured statistics on registered payment systems (including international card schemes operating in Ukraine) and infrastructure operators — richer and more comparable than one-off news releases.

source_name: UnionPay International — Media Center (news / market updates)
why_relevant: UnionPay's own newsroom is the only first-party record of its Ukrainian acceptance and issuance footprint (PrivatBank issuance, Ukrgasbank acceptance, PROSTIR–UnionPay co-badged card), including acceptance-point and ATM counts.

source_name: NBU news: first PROSTIR–UnionPay co-badged card in Ukraine
why_relevant: Documents the national scheme's cross-border co-badging strategy — the mechanism by which PROSTIR gains international acceptance without Visa/Mastercard. Directly on-cell for cross-border infrastructure.

source_name: НАБУ / Незалежна асоціація банків України — banking association position papers on interchange & acquiring
why_relevant: The banking association (Olena Korobkova) publicly argues the issuer side of the interchange-cap debate and quotes market-level acquiring economics — an actor whose disclosures reveal scheme-adjacent numbers the schemes will not state.

source_name: Верховна Рада legislative portal — interchange/acquiring bills (4178, 4178-1)
why_relevant: Draft laws capping interchange and acquiring commissions are the regulatory forcing function on scheme economics in Ukraine; the parliamentary card pages give bill text, explanatory notes, committee conclusions and status — primary and dated.

source_name: Kansas City Fed — Credit and Debit Card Interchange Fees in Various Countries (Ukraine entry)
why_relevant: Independent, regularly updated cross-country compilation that includes Ukraine's interchange caps — useful for benchmarking Ukraine against EU/other markets and for validating scheme-published rates from an external vantage point.

source_name: European Business Association (EBA Ukraine) — member-company payment announcements
why_relevant: Visa and Mastercard are EBA members and route Ukraine-specific commercial announcements (e.g. interchange reductions) through it; bilingual uk/en pages make it a useful secondary confirmation channel for scheme actions.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk) — ПРОСТІР (платіжна система)
why_relevant: Not a citable statistic source, but an efficient entry point to the PROSTIR actor map: predecessor names (НСМЕП), participant counts, co-badging history and a footnote trail into NBU documents and older regulations.

source_name: Асоціація українських банків (АУБ) / Association of Ukrainian Banks — Показники діяльності банків
why_relevant: AUB is the oldest Ukrainian banking association and historically publishes bank-by-bank performance indicator tables (assets, liabilities, capital, deposits, loans) compiled from member/NBU reporting. This is the classic association-level aggregation of banking market statistics and a ready-made ranking series for market-share work.

source_name: НАБУ — Банки-учасники (member bank register)
why_relevant: Explicit member register of the largest banking association — the cheapest structured map of which banks are active and organised in Ukraine, and a seed list for per-bank scouting (annual reports, ATM/POS fleet disclosures).

source_name: НАБУ — Асоційовані члени (associate members: vendors, processors, IT)
why_relevant: Associate-member lists of banking associations typically contain the technology vendors, processors, ATM/POS suppliers and consultancies serving the banks — exactly the competitor/partner ecosystem map for a payments-hardware and services player.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — реєстр членів (member register)
why_relevant: Verified by fetch: roughly 80+ member logos covering banks (PrivatBank, Oschadbank, PUMB, Raiffeisen, OTP, Citi), schemes (Visa, Mastercard), processors and PSPs (Platon, NovaPay, EasyPay, iPay.ua), marketplaces (OLX, Prom.ua, Rozetka Pay) and even Moldovan banks (MAIB, Victoriabank). This is the single densest actor map of the Ukrainian cashless ecosystem.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — AntiFraud HUB
why_relevant: EMA's cross-member anti-fraud data exchange. Its aggregate outputs (annual social-engineering loss totals, average fraudulent transaction size, share of citizens contacted by fraudsters) are association-only statistics widely re-quoted by Forbes.ua, Fintech Insider and banks — an indirect but strong proxy for cashless transaction volume and channel mix.

source_name: Український кредитно-банківський союз (УКБС / UCBU)
why_relevant: A second, older (registered 1994) banking association reportedly uniting ~92 financial-credit institutions including foreign bank representative offices. Useful as an alternative voice to NABU/AUB on regulation, and its membership skews to smaller and non-bank credit institutions that the big-bank associations underrepresent.

source_name: Асоціація рітейлерів України (RAU) — RAU Analytics
why_relevant: RAU unites 90+ Ukrainian and international retail chains and runs a regular monthly member survey (reported at ~110 respondents). Its analytics cover retail geography by region and, jointly with NielsenIQ, wartime shifts in sales structure and consumer interaction — the merchant-side demand signal for POS terminals and acquiring.

source_name: Асоціація рітейлерів України (RAU) — e-commerce / E-Meeting industry track
why_relevant: RAU convenes e-commerce market-player roundtables (E-Meeting series) on responsibility and regulation of online trade, where online-payment friction and acquiring terms are debated. Event write-ups name the participating merchants and PSPs — pointer value on top of content value.

source_name: Diia.Business — Ukrainian Fintech Catalog case page (state mirror of UAFIC research)
why_relevant: A government portal mirror/landing for the association's fintech market research, plus a separate Diia.Business entry describing EMA. Useful as a stable, fetch-friendly alternative route to association outputs when the association's own site is JS-heavy, and as evidence of which associations the state treats as official interlocutors.

source_name: European Business Association Ukraine (EBA) — Finance & Banking committee surveys
why_relevant: EBA runs recurring member surveys on access to finance jointly with member banks (e.g. the 2025 MSME survey with UKRSIBBANK, 74 CFO/CEO respondents, fielded 21 May–4 Jun 2025, reporting payment-term distributions and financing barriers). Bilingual output and a large corporate membership make it a reliable business-side complement to bank-side associations.

source_name: Global Business for Ukraine (GB4U) — Finance Access Survey
why_relevant: Co-publisher with EBA of the MSME finance-access survey; hosts the survey landing page independently, giving a second retrieval path and sometimes fuller methodology than the EBA news item.

source_name: Українська Асоціація Маркетингу (УАМ / Ukrainian Marketing Association)
why_relevant: Professional association with collective and individual members whose core activity is market research and public-opinion polling. Relevant as a pointer to the Ukrainian research-agency supply side (who can field a consumer payments survey) and occasionally as a publisher of consumer-behaviour data touching payment methods.

source_name: Українська Рада Торгових Центрів (УРТЦ / Ukrainian Council of Shopping Centers)
why_relevant: Shopping-centre industry body that publishes e-commerce and retail recovery trend pieces. Shopping-centre footfall and tenant-mix data are the physical-acceptance backdrop for POS terminal estate planning, and the council's members are the landlords of most large card-accepting merchants.

source_name: Українська асоціація постачальників торговельних мереж (UASTS)
why_relevant: Supplier-side association (founded 2010 after the Okey Ukraine chain collapse) representing producers and distributors selling into grocery chains. Its subject matter is payment terms, receivables and chain solvency — an indirect but direct-to-the-point view of B2B payment behaviour in retail supply chains.

source_name: Всеукраїнська асоціація фінансових компаній (ВАФК)
why_relevant: Association of Ukrainian non-bank financial companies (USREOU 40337251) — the segment that now holds NBU payment-institution and e-money licences. Its positions on non-bank payment regulation are not covered by the bank associations, so it fills a real gap even though its publishing footprint is thin.

source_name: ATM Industry Association (ATMIA) — Europe region
why_relevant: The only ATM-sector self-regulatory body plausibly covering Ukraine, since no domestic Ukrainian ATM/cash-in-transit association was located. Its Europe region pages, loyal-member list and industry reports are the route to ATM deployment benchmarks and cash-access policy positions that Ukrainian deployers benchmark against.

source_name: Minfin / PSM7 / Fintech Insider reporting on banking-association positions (association-position aggregator route)
why_relevant: Ukrainian financial media reliably reproduce association position papers that the associations themselves publish only as PDFs or member letters — e.g. the July 2026 report that the banking association urged against cutting card interchange to EU levels, arguing card income sustains payment-system continuity in wartime. A practical fallback when association sites throttle or gate.
